Package dev.px.core.notification

Class Notification

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.notification.Notification
public final class Notification extends Object
One transient message shown on screen.

Carries its own slide-in animation and expiry, so the renderer is a loop that draws whatever NotificationService.getActive() returns and never has to track per-notification state.
